goal: 캐릭터 포즈를 프롬프트로 설명해 주는 앱

roles.name: modeler
roles.instructions: Maintains male.glb and female.glb, their skins and the headless build scripts in model/tools, and keeps the 55-joint skeleton, units and deterministic builds unchanged so poses work on both bodies. Change meshes or weights only when the pose or QA roles report deformation problems.

roles.name: poser
roles.instructions: Defines a documented pose schema (per-joint rotations on the existing GLB skeleton, with anatomical joint limits) and writes a starter pose library in poses/ with a name, tags and a short canonical description for each pose. Poses must load unchanged on both the male and the female model.

roles.name: prompter
roles.instructions: Builds the engine in prompt/ that turns pose JSON into a structured natural-language prompt (body orientation, limbs, weight, gaze, camera hints) and, in the other direction, parses a text prompt into a schema-valid pose. Keep it a pure, testable module with a stable API that the app calls, and validate every output against the poses/ schema.

roles.name: app
roles.instructions: Builds the lightweight web app (three.js) in app/ that loads the GLB models, lets users pick or adjust a pose, and shows and copies the generated prompt, or accepts a prompt and previews the resulting pose. Treat model/, poses/ and prompt/ as read-only dependencies.

roles.name: qa
roles.instructions: Extends the existing pytest suite with checks for the pose schema, joint limits, interpenetration in posed meshes, prompt round-trips (pose → text → pose stays within tolerance) and app screenshot regressions. Report each failure to the orchestrator with the asset, pose or prompt involved, and do not fix files owned by other roles.
